descriptions.ambiguous: Events may remain unexplained, or have plausible natural causes; no definitive supernatural claim.
descriptions.supernatural: Explicitly fictional paranormal interpretation, optional and entirely non-graphic.
descriptions.off: Default. No story progression, notifications or journal access.

safety: no real deities classified as monsters
no official alerts or current-news claims
persistence: In-memory gameplay service; SQL only models future persistence and is not connected.
authentication: Developer-only unauthenticated API; production requires authenticated character ownership.
source: Unified Master Specification Part I §37 and Phase 40, pp. 32–33 and 57–58
